subject: general
question: According to APEDA report 2020 which Indian state has the highest percentage of commercially cultivated floriculture?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **According to APEDA report 2020, Tamil Nadu has the highest percentage of commercially cultivated floriculture.**
 
• The Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA) is an Indian Apex-Export Trade Promotion Active government body, founded on 13 February 1986.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• APEDA actively supported the Government in taking the export of agricultural products to **USD 20.67 billion in 2020-21 from USD 0.6 billion in 1986** when it was founded. 
 
• APEDA also helped expand the export basket to 205 countries.
 
• The share of APEDA exports (USD 20.67 billion) constituted 49% of overall agri- product exports in 2020-21 out of which, Cereals and fresh horticulture comprised 59%, Cereal preparations and miscellaneous processed items 23% and animal products 18%.
 
• The target given to APEDA in the current financial year (2021-22) is **USD 23.7 billion, out of which more than 70% i.e.**
 
• **USD 17.20 billion** has been achieved till January 2022, and the remaining target is expected to be completed within the stipulated time period.
